pages.phone: Cards; sheet full width; no primary action.
uxNotes: Refunding a whole (non-shop) order is a red button with no confirm, while the shop refund and ticket cancel both ask first.
Label drift: the page is 'Zahlungen' but rows/sheet are 'Bestellung' and the empty text says 'Noch keine Bestellungen.'; the column is 'Kunde' (not gendered) while shop uses 'Käufer:in'.
Status labels are lowercase ('offen', 'bezahlt') unlike capitalised statuses elsewhere (shop 'Bezahlt', tickets 'Gültig').
Refund form uses refund.bind(null, id) instead of the hidden id field the rules require.
The order sheet is the target of links from tickets and shop (?edit=<pay order id>), so it acts as a record page but is a sheet; there is no deep page per payment.
Refund hint 'Stripe bestätigt sie gleich' is Stripe-specific although SumUp is also supported.
No export (payments are money data an accountant would want).
Empty list has no EmptyState explaining where payments come from.

redesign.job: See every incoming payment (tickets, shop, tests) with its state, find one, refund if needed.
redesign.phone: Top bar: Zahlungen, ⋯ (export, Testzahlung for platform admins). Provider hint card if not connected. Toolbar: search, then a scrolling row: Status filter, Wofür filter, event/contact chip. Cards: customer + status badge, line 2 Wofür · date, amount. Row → sheet.
redesign.desktop: <ListToolbar> search · Status · Wofür · chips. Table: Kunde:in (name, muted email), Wofür, Datum, Status badge, Betrag right. Sheet ?edit=<id>: title 'Zahlung · amount', badge, DetailList, Positionen, Tickets, Vorgänge, Erstattungen, Verknüpft (event, shop order, invoice), Erstatten form with confirm.
